pairs.subject: native-document-format
pairs.evidence: app/features/tools/profile/useProfileEditorSubmit.ts:83 The editor saves a candidate profile only by POSTing or PUTting JSON to /api/profile, which writes a SQLite row through app/_lib/db/profiles.ts (saveProfileForCv/updateProfile). The application owns that schema and migrates it, so no profile document ever leaves the application as a file with an unbounded set of readers. A search of app/features/tools/profile/ for schemaVersion, formatVersion, Blob, download, showSaveFilePicker and FileReader found no file export or import path.

techniques.evidence: app/features/tools/profile/profileEditorBackup.ts:70 Nothing here is a saved document. The nearest analogue is the tab-scoped sessionStorage backup, which does carry a generation stamp (v: 2), and planRestore offers a pre-envelope backup instead of applying it. Read that way, it is a declared generation.

app/features/tools/profile/useProfileEditorSubmit.ts:83 There is no save format to design. The downstream consumer (profile_cli) receives a temporary intake.json that the route writes for each request and then deletes. That is an IPC payload, not a persisted document.

app/features/tools/profile/useProfileEditorFields.ts:43 The only client-side persistence is deliberately limited to the tab. No document stores or relinks external assets. Evidence links are plain URL strings inside a database row.
